connector.name: Weavatrix Online
connector.registryDescription: Source-free Weavatrix MCP: preview-gated sync, advisories, malware review, architecture contracts.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package weavatrix-online. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the sergii-ziborov account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: WEAVATRIX_SYNC_URL
env.description: Cloud or compatible self-hosted sync endpoint

env.name: WEAVATRIX_SYNC_TOKEN
env.description: Scoped bearer token for the selected endpoint

env.name: WEAVATRIX_CAPABILITIES_URL
env.description: Optional explicit endpoint capability document URL; defaults to /api/v1/capabilities on the sync origin with legacy /api/health fallback

env.name: WEAVATRIX_PRECISION
env.description: Core semantic precision: lsp (default) or off

env.name: WEAVATRIX_ALLOW_SOURCE_EDITS
env.description: Set to 1 only for sessions authorized to apply or roll back refactor plans

env.name: WEAVATRIX_ALLOW_TEST_RUNS
env.description: Set to 1 only to authorize requested verified_change package scripts
